release.release_notes:
GaiaOS 0.4.8-beta.17 — Home, Playing and navigation feedback

Tap PS/Xbox/Guide/Home to return to Home while keeping the running software paused; hold for 500 ms to open the quick menu. The Playing tile shows the profile avatar and resumes the same process. Start + Select remains the hold-only fallback. The quick menu has the narrower layout, inline volume slider, status/time and pinned Power controls. Navigation has faster animated glow, bottom-button icon bounce and the three supplied randomized click sounds.

Fresh Debian 13 amd64 launcher build from latest main, source 3e7b714006e36e9620f384e28978f5d5f2ee35f0, including HOME-086 implementation 3cd6842. Original Ed25519 trust identity preserved; signing stays local.

System assessment: published system Beta 15 (257cbe2c2089627534e4d2ab378349455d47c92d) already contains required OS packages, Dolphin, controller HID rules and external-drive support. No OS recipe or native runtime dependency changes since that baseline. Compatible A/B installations should install system Beta 15 if needed, reboot, then check Beta again for this launcher. No new ISO, system bundle or disk migration. Old Beta 4 certificate-purpose verification still requires corrected installation media/reinstall.

Python, QML, ShellCheck, native CTest and focused real-launcher quick-menu checks are run before signing/publication. Broad headless held-list timing remains a known intermittent QA limitation. VM/hardware boot/update/rollback, physical controllers, real audio, gameplay and save/resume acceptance remain pending Chris. Process/audio fixtures do not establish physical-device or gameplay acceptance.
